class.name: DesignComposer
class.brief_description: Tier 2 studio workspace for architectural blueprints, assembly recipes, and 3D themes.
class.description: Organizes [BlueprintResource] assets under [b]Blueprints[/b] (hosting [BlueprintEditorControl]), [ParametricAssemblyRecipeResource] assets under [b]Recipes[/b], and [Theme3DResource] / [Style3DResource] assets under [b]Themes & Styles[/b].

method.name: open_design_resource
method.description: Opens or focuses the shared [DesignComposer] window and loads [param resource].
